categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in intelligent terminals, communication modules and industry application solutions, and operation services including related software systems and platforms. Key products include smart set-top boxes, ONU smart home gateways, integrated smart home gateways, smart routers, smart cameras, HarmonyOS terminals, NB-IoT modules, LTE and 5G RedCap communication modules, optical modules, smart city data platforms, information security products, new energy products, smart robots, smart meters, energy storage PACK batteries, FTTR, WiFi7 routers, and photovoltaic projects. The company also focuses on emerging areas such as HarmonyOS ecosystem products, smart city platforms, new energy, and intelligent manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed 11 core general technologies and 16 proprietary core technologies covering multiple business areas, including embedded software development compatible with Android, Linux, and HarmonyOS, digital TV protocol stack technology, WiFi wireless LAN technology, PON access network technology, IoT system integration, NB-IoT and 4G/5G cellular communication technologies, high-rate optical signal transmission, and commercial secret security protection. It also possesses 5 core intelligent manufacturing technologies such as fully automated production lines, ROM automatic burning, vision-based positioning for robotic arms, automated product functional testing, and MES system for production management. The company emphasizes smart manufacturing and has passed CMMI certification.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company mainly serves telecom operators including China Mobile, China Telecom, and China Unicom, as well as broadcasting operators across more than 20 provinces in China. Its products are widely used in digital home entertainment, smart home networking, IoT applications, smart cities, smart energy, and new energy sectors. The company is expanding into overseas markets and non-operator channels such as offline and e-commerce platforms. Key verticals include energy, finance, medical, education, industrial IoT, and smart city governance.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Huizhou, Guangdong Province. It has subsidiaries and branches in Beijing, Shanghai, Tianjin, Zhengzhou, and overseas entities in Hong Kong and Singapore. Domestic sales dominate revenue, with international sales accounting for a smaller portion and facing some decline due to geopolitical factors. The company is actively expanding its presence in Asia-Pacific and other global markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on R&D, manufacturing, and sales of intelligent terminals and communication modules. It integrates hardware and software development, production, and after-sales services. The company maintains strong supplier relationships and emphasizes supply chain integration and localization, including the use of domestic components to ensure product quality and supply stability.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding digital home networking and multimedia entertainment devices, accelerating 5G and IoT product development, promoting HarmonyOS ecosystem products, advancing smart city platforms, and developing new energy and intelligent manufacturing capabilities. The company invests heavily in R&D, focusing on 5G RedCap modules, WiFi7 routers, FTTR solutions, AI-enabled smart devices, and edge computing. It also emphasizes patent and standard leadership, participating in international and national standard setting.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of intelligent terminals, communication modules, and smart devices customized for telecom operators and industry clients. The company also earns income from operation services including smart city projects, photovoltaic energy projects, and technical support services. Additional revenue streams include software licensing, government subsidies, and investment income from equity holdings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in the intelligent set-top box and smart home networking market, holding significant market share with major telecom operators. It competes with other Chinese manufacturers in the digital home and IoT sectors. The company leverages its early mover advantage, strong R&D capabilities, and comprehensive product portfolio to maintain a competitive edge. It is recognized as a core contributor to the HarmonyOS ecosystem and a key participant in smart city and new energy markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.5 billion, representing a 15.54% increase year-over-year. Despite a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 141.8 million, the loss narrowed compared to the previous year. The company’s total assets grew by 23.48% to approximately RMB 3.69 billion. R&D investment accounted for nearly 7% of revenue. The company has a workforce of over 1,500 employees, with more than 600 in R&D roles, reflecting a strong focus on innovation and growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes technological innovation, product quality, and comprehensive service to deliver superior digital home and IoT solutions. It differentiates through advanced embedded software compatible with multiple operating systems including HarmonyOS, high-performance hardware supporting 8K video and WiFi7, and integrated smart home networking solutions. Its leadership in standard setting, extensive patent portfolio, and intelligent manufacturing capabilities provide competitive advantages. The company also focuses on eco-friendly energy solutions and smart city platforms, aligning with national digitalization and sustainability goals.
